cards.text: You give Des one address. He doesn't write it down.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Physics. Good — that's somebody sorted by the weekend." He's pleased in a way that takes a second to read as pleased.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Still want a fate patch off you an' all. City, for preference — nobody round here's got the ground for it. No rush."
By the end of the week, one patch you found has a vein in it and it isn't yours. You seem fine with this.
